title: HTTP methods, status codes and JSON

objectives.text: Choose GET, POST, PUT or DELETE for an operation and say which methods are safe or idempotent
Pick a status code class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx) and a specific code for a response
Read and write a JSON object with nested values and arrays
